<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, provide } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { messageKey } from "../../message/src/context";
import {
  bubbleKey,
  type MessageBubbleAlign,
  type MessageBubbleVariant,
} from "./context";
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    variant?: MessageBubbleVariant;
    align?: MessageBubbleAlign;
    animateIn?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { variant: "soft", animateIn: false },
);
const parent = inject(
  messageKey,
  computed(() => "assistant" as const),
);
const alignment = computed(
  () => props.align ?? (parent.value === "user" ? "end" : "start"),
);
const context = computed(() => ({
  align: alignment.value,
  variant: props.variant,
  animateIn: props.animateIn,
}));
provide(bubbleKey, context);
const reduced = useReducedMotion();
</script>
<template>
  <motion.div
    data-slot="message-bubble"
    :data-align="alignment"
    :data-variant="variant"
    :class="
      cn(
        'group/bubble flex w-full flex-col',
        alignment === 'end' ? 'items-end' : 'items-start',
      )
    "
    :exit="{ opacity: 0, y: -3, scale: 0.99 }"
    :transition="reduced ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT"
    ><slot
  /></motion.div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, provide, ref, type Component } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { EASE_OUT, SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { bubbleKey, bubbleLayoutKey } from "./context";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ as?: string | Component }>(), {
  as: "div",
});
const context = inject(
  bubbleKey,
  computed(() => ({
    align: "start" as const,
    variant: "soft" as const,
    animateIn: false,
  })),
);
const reduced = useReducedMotion();
const revision = ref(0);
provide(bubbleLayoutKey, () => {
  revision.value++;
});
const variants = {
  solid: "bg-foreground",
  soft: "bg-muted",
  tint: "bg-muted",
  outline: "border border-border/70 bg-background",
  ghost: "",
  danger: "bg-destructive/10",
};
const classes = computed(() =>
  cn(
    context.value.variant === "solid" && "text-background",
    context.value.variant === "danger" && "text-destructive",
    context.value.variant === "ghost" &&
      "w-full max-w-none rounded-none px-0 py-0",
    ["button", "a"].includes(props.as as string) &&
      "cursor-pointer text-left outline-none transition-[background-color,color,transform] duration-150 hover:brightness-[0.98] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring active:scale-[0.99]",
  ),
);
</script>
<template>
  <component
    :is="as"
    data-slot="message-bubble-content"
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :class="
      cn(
        'relative z-0 min-w-9 max-w-[82%] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm leading-6 text-foreground [&_a]:font-medium [&_a]:underline [&_a]:underline-offset-4 [&_code]:rounded [&_code]:bg-background/60 [&_code]:px-1 [&_code]:py-0.5 [&_code]:font-mono [&_code]:text-[0.9em] [&_ol]:my-2 [&_ol]:list-decimal [&_ol]:pl-5 [&_p+p]:mt-2 [&_pre]:my-2 [&_pre]:overflow-x-auto [&_pre]:rounded-xl [&_pre]:bg-background/60 [&_pre]:p-3 [&_ul]:my-2 [&_ul]:list-disc [&_ul]:pl-5',
        classes,
        $attrs.class,
      )
    "
  >
    <motion.span
      v-if="context.variant !== 'ghost'"
      aria-hidden="true"
      :layout="reduced ? false : 'size'"
      :layout-dependency="revision"
      :initial="
        context.animateIn && !reduced ? { opacity: 0, scale: 0.92 } : false
      "
      :animate="{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }"
      :transition="
        reduced
          ? { duration: 0 }
          : {
              opacity: { duration: 0.12, ease: EASE_OUT },
              scale: {
                type: 'spring',
                stiffness: 520,
                damping: 27,
                mass: 0.52,
              },
              layout: SPRING_LAYOUT,
            }
      "
      :class="
        cn(
          'pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 -z-10 rounded-[inherit]',
          context.align === 'end'
            ? 'origin-bottom-right'
            : 'origin-bottom-left',
          variants[context.variant],
        )
      "
    />
    <motion.div
      class="relative"
      :initial="context.animateIn ? { opacity: 0 } : false"
      :animate="{ opacity: 1 }"
      :transition="{
        duration: 0.12,
        ease: EASE_OUT,
        delay: reduced ? 0 : 0.04,
      }"
      ><slot
    /></motion.div>
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, renderSlot, useAttrs } from "vue";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ spacing?: "compact" | "default" }>(), {
  spacing: "compact",
});
const slots = defineSlots<{ default?(props: {}): any }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const gaps = { compact: "gap-1.5", default: "gap-3" } as const;
const RenderFrame = () =>
  h(
    "div",
    {
      "data-slot": "message-bubble-group",
      ...attrs,
      class: cn(
        "flex w-full flex-col",
        gaps[props.spacing === "compact" ? "compact" : "default"],
        attrs.class,
      ),
    },
    [renderSlot(slots, "default")],
  );
</script>
<template><RenderFrame /></template>

export { default as MessageScroller } from "./src/MessageScroller.vue";

export type * from "./src/api-types";

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { useReduced } from "../../shared";
import { messageKey, type MessageFrom } from "./context";
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{ from: MessageFrom; animateIn?: boolean }>(),
  { animateIn: false },
);
const side = computed(() => props.from);
provide(messageKey, side);
const reduced = useReduced();
const initial = computed(() =>
  props.animateIn && !reduced.value ? { opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.95 } : false,
);
</script>
<template>
  <motion.article
    data-slot="message"
    :data-from="from"
    :aria-label="`${from} message`"
    :class="
      cn(
        'group/message flex w-full items-start gap-2',
        from === 'user' ? 'flex-row-reverse' : 'flex-row',
      )
    "
    :style="{ transformOrigin: from === 'user' ? '100% 100%' : '0% 100%' }"
    :initial="initial"
    :animate="{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }"
    :exit="reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: -3, scale: 0.99 }"
    :transition="
      reduced
        ? { duration: 0.12 }
        : { type: 'spring', stiffness: 480, damping: 32, mass: 0.62 }
    "
    ><slot
  /></motion.article>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, renderSlot, useAttrs } from "vue";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ placeholder?: boolean }>(), {
  placeholder: false,
});
const slots = defineSlots<{ default?(props: {}): any }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const frame =
  "grid size-7 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground [&_img]:size-full [&_img]:object-cover [&_svg]:size-3.5";
const RenderFrame = () => {
  const presentation = props.placeholder
    ? { class: "invisible", hidden: true }
    : { class: undefined, hidden: undefined };
  return h(
    "div",
    {
      "data-slot": "message-avatar",
      ...attrs,
      "aria-hidden": presentation.hidden,
      class: cn(frame, presentation.class, attrs.class),
    },
    [renderSlot(slots, "default")],
  );
};
</script>
<template><RenderFrame /></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, renderSlot, useAttrs } from "vue";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ spacing?: "compact" | "default" }>(), {
  spacing: "compact",
});
const slots = defineSlots<{ default?(props: {}): any }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const gaps = { compact: "gap-1.5", default: "gap-4" } as const;
const RenderFrame = () =>
  h(
    "div",
    {
      "data-slot": "message-group",
      ...attrs,
      class: cn(
        "flex w-full flex-col",
        gaps[props.spacing === "compact" ? "compact" : "default"],
        attrs.class,
      ),
    },
    [renderSlot(slots, "default")],
  );
</script>
<template><RenderFrame /></template>
